quotes.name: 1280 MHz
quotes.text: Huge fan of Blip! Literally iMessage in @omarchy (does require a Mac on the network)

quotes.name: Ding
quotes.text: This Omarchy plugin is bar far my most used and favorite

quotes.name: John
quotes.text: This has been super helpful to me. I can get 2FA codes without opening my phone, quickly check a text, etc. Thank you!

quotes.name: Joel Gaff, Jr.
quotes.text: @NixFred for making Blip. Such a clutch tool on my Omarchy machine.

quotes.name: Spencer
quotes.text: Bought a 2018 MacBook Pro with a broken screen just so it could run Blip or BlueBubbles for my Omarchy installs

quotes.name: Jason Alexander
quotes.text: there's a great project by @NixFred called blip that does proxying of iMessage to a client in Omarchy. Pair that with tailscale, and you're golden!

quotes.text: Blip is awesome! Thank you so much.
